title: Berisha faction action at Democratic Party headquarters
reason: The body-read accounts identify the action’s immediate objective as taking control of the Democratic Party headquarters in an intra-party leadership dispute. They do not establish a specific demand to Albania’s government or its policy. The later anti-government campaign rhetoric does not establish that this gathering pressed a government demand. Exclude as a party leadership conflict outside the state-directed protest scope.
notes: The Guardian/AP describes hundreds of participants and a three-hour action, police dispersal and detention; RFE/RL reports the same action but gives no count. Do not count AP-origin republications independently. The event is excluded for target/scope, not for size or lack of publicness.

title: Tirana protest against Serbian President Vučić’s visit and Open Balkan
reason: The body-read source dates the protest to Dec. 20, 2021, before the January unit. No evidence links it to a continuous action that continued into January.
notes: RFE/RL reports thousands and describes opposition to Vučić’s visit/Open Balkan; this is boundary context only. The reported crowd cannot be transferred to a January event.

title: Announced teacher class stoppage and proposed January demonstration
reason: The source set establishes announcements, not that either action took place. Follow-up search results suggested withdrawal/cancellation, but the relevant bodies were not retrieved. A planned action is not coded as an occurred public gathering without execution evidence.
notes: This exclusion records insufficient execution evidence, not a confirmed cancellation or proof that no action occurred. Preserve the unresolved follow-up in gaps.
